properties.name: auth.service.url
properties.description: Base URL of the authentication service (used for JWT validation and inter-service communication). Set with AUTH_SERVICE_URL.

properties.name: auth.service.api-key
properties.description: Shared service key for calls to auth-service. Must be the same value as API_KEY in auth-service. Without it no notification emails are sent. Set with INTERNAL_API_KEY.

properties.name: jwt.secret
properties.description: Base64-encoded secret key used to sign and verify JWT tokens. Must match across all microservices.

properties.name: jwt.expiration
properties.description: JWT access token expiration time in milliseconds.

properties.name: jwt.refresh-expiration
properties.description: JWT refresh token expiration time in milliseconds.

properties.name: message.delivery.retry-attempts
properties.description: Maximum number of retry attempts for failed message delivery to users.

properties.name: message.delivery.retry-delay-ms
properties.description: Delay in milliseconds between message delivery retry attempts with exponential backoff.

properties.name: message.idempotency-timeout-hours
properties.description: Duration in hours to keep idempotency keys for preventing duplicate message sends.

properties.name: message.edit-window-hours
properties.description: How many hours after sending a person can edit their own message. 0 turns editing off. Set with MESSAGE_EDIT_WINDOW_HOURS.

properties.name: rate-limit.requests-per-minute
properties.description: Maximum number of HTTP requests allowed per minute per client IP address.

properties.name: rate-limit.websocket-messages-per-minute
properties.description: Maximum number of WebSocket STOMP messages allowed per minute per connected client.

properties.name: websocket.stomp.heartbeat.client
properties.description: STOMP heartbeat interval in milliseconds that clients send to the server.

properties.name: websocket.stomp.heartbeat.server
properties.description: STOMP heartbeat interval in milliseconds that the server sends to connected clients.

properties.name: spring.task.execution.pool.thread-name-prefix
properties.description: Prefix for async task executor thread names for easier debugging in logs.

properties.name: spring.task.execution.pool.core-size
properties.description: Core number of threads in the async task executor thread pool.

properties.name: spring.task.execution.pool.max-size
properties.description: Maximum number of threads in the async task executor thread pool.

properties.name: spring.task.execution.pool.queue-capacity
properties.description: Queue capacity for async tasks waiting to be executed.

properties.name: spring.task.execution.pool.wait-for-tasks-to-complete-on-shutdown
properties.description: Whether to wait for remaining async tasks to complete on application shutdown.

properties.name: spring.task.execution.pool.await-termination-period
properties.description: Maximum time to wait for async tasks to complete on shutdown.

properties.name: feign.client.config.default.connect-timeout
properties.description: Feign HTTP client connection timeout in milliseconds for inter-service calls.

properties.name: feign.client.config.default.read-timeout
properties.description: Feign HTTP client read timeout in milliseconds for inter-service calls.

properties.name: feign.compression.request.enabled
properties.description: Enable GZIP compression for Feign HTTP requests.

properties.name: feign.compression.request.min-request-size
properties.description: Minimum request size in bytes before Feign applies compression.

properties.name: server.tomcat.max-http-form-post-size
properties.description: Maximum size in bytes for HTTP form POST requests.

properties.name: server.tomcat.connection-timeout
properties.description: Tomcat connection timeout for establishing HTTP connections.

properties.name: server.tomcat.threads.max
properties.description: Maximum number of request processing threads in Tomcat.

properties.name: server.tomcat.threads.min-spare
properties.description: Minimum number of spare request processing threads in Tomcat.

properties.name: server.tomcat.max-connections
properties.description: Maximum number of connections Tomcat will accept.

properties.name: server.compression.enabled
properties.description: Enable response compression (gzip) for responses larger than min-response-size.

properties.name: server.compression.min-response-size
properties.description: Minimum response size in bytes before compression is applied.

properties.name: server.port
properties.description: Server HTTP port.

properties.name: server.shutdown
properties.description: Server shutdown strategy (immediate, graceful).

properties.name: server.servlet.context-path
properties.description: Context path of the web application.

properties.name: spring.mongodb.uri
properties.description: MongoDB connection string URI. Set with MONGODB_URI.

properties.name: spring.data.mongodb.auto-index-creation
properties.description: Enable automatic MongoDB index creation from @Indexed annotations.

properties.name: spring.data.redis.url
properties.description: Redis server URL connection string.

properties.name: spring.data.redis.timeout
properties.description: Redis connection timeout duration.

properties.name: spring.data.redis.connect-timeout
properties.description: Redis connection establish timeout duration.

properties.name: spring.data.redis.lettuce.pool.max-active
properties.description: Maximum number of active connections in Redis Lettuce connection pool.

properties.name: spring.data.redis.lettuce.pool.max-idle
properties.description: Maximum number of idle connections in Redis Lettuce connection pool.

properties.name: spring.data.redis.lettuce.pool.min-idle
properties.description: Minimum number of idle connections in Redis Lettuce connection pool.

properties.name: spring.cache.type
properties.description: Cache type to use (redis, caffeine, simple, none).

properties.name: spring.cache.redis.time-to-live
properties.description: Default cache TTL for all Redis caches.

properties.name: spring.cache.cache-names
properties.description: List of cache names to initialize on startup.

properties.name: spring.jackson.default-property-inclusion
properties.description: Inclusion strategy for serializing properties (non_null = exclude null values).

properties.name: spring.jackson.serialization.write-dates-as-timestamps
properties.description: Whether to write dates as timestamps (false = use ISO-8601 format).

properties.name: spring.jackson.deserialization.fail-on-unknown-properties
properties.description: Whether to fail if unknown properties are found during deserialization.

properties.name: spring.servlet.multipart.max-file-size
properties.description: Maximum allowed file size per upload. Set with STORAGE_MAX_FILE_SIZE.

properties.name: spring.servlet.multipart.max-request-size
properties.description: Maximum allowed request size for multipart uploads. Set with STORAGE_MAX_REQUEST_SIZE and keep it a little above the largest file.

properties.name: spring.security.user.name
properties.description: User name for the actuator basic authentication. Set with ACTUATOR_USER.

properties.name: spring.security.user.password
properties.description: Password for the actuator basic authentication. Set with ACTUATOR_PASSWORD.

properties.name: logging.level.root
properties.description: Root logger level.

properties.name: logging.pattern.console
properties.description: Log pattern for console output.

properties.name: logging.file.name
properties.description: Log file name and path.

properties.name: logging.file.max-size
properties.description: Maximum size of log file before rotation.

properties.name: logging.file.max-history
properties.description: Maximum number of backup log files to keep.

properties.name: logging.file.total-size-cap
properties.description: Total size cap for all log files combined.

properties.name: management.server.port
properties.description: Management endpoints server port.

properties.name: management.endpoints.web.base-path
properties.description: Base path for management web endpoints.

properties.name: management.endpoints.web.exposure.include
properties.description: Comma-separated list of management endpoints to expose.

properties.name: management.endpoint.health.show-details
properties.description: When to show health details: never, when-authorized, always.

properties.name: management.endpoint.health.probes.enabled
properties.description: Enable Kubernetes probe endpoints (/health/live, /health/ready, /health/startup).

properties.name: management.endpoint.health.livenessState.enabled
properties.description: Enable the liveness state for Kubernetes liveness probes.

properties.name: management.endpoint.health.readinessState.enabled
properties.description: Enable the readiness state for Kubernetes readiness probes.

properties.name: management.endpoint.metrics.enabled
properties.description: Enable the metrics management endpoint.

properties.name: management.metrics.export.prometheus.enabled
properties.description: Enable Prometheus metrics export at /actuator/prometheus endpoint.

properties.name: management.metrics.distribution.percentiles-histogram.[messenger.message.send.latency]
properties.description: Enable percentile histogram for message send latency metric.

properties.name: management.metrics.tags.application
properties.description: Application name tag for metrics.

properties.name: notifications.email-enabled
properties.description: Master switch for notification emails, such as group changes (made an admin or the owner, added to or removed from a group) and tags. Notifications always appear in the app. Emails go through auth-service and need auth.service.api-key. Set with NOTIFICATION_EMAILS_ENABLED.

properties.name: notifications.mention-email-cooldown-minutes
properties.description: Tagging someone with @ or everyone with @all always notifies in the app. The email is held back so a burst of tagged messages is one email: at most one per person and chat in this many minutes. Set with MENTION_EMAIL_COOLDOWN_MINUTES.

properties.name: notifications.mention-all-email-max-members
properties.description: An @all in a group with more people than this notifies in the app only, with no emails. Set with MENTION_ALL_EMAIL_MAX_MEMBERS.

properties.name: status.max-hours
properties.description: The longest a status can stay, in hours. Nobody can choose more than this. Set with STATUS_MAX_HOURS.

properties.name: status.default-hours
properties.description: How long a status stays when the person does not choose, in hours. Never above status.max-hours. Set with STATUS_DEFAULT_HOURS.

properties.name: status.text-max-length
properties.description: Most characters in a text status or a caption. Set with STATUS_TEXT_MAX_LENGTH.

properties.name: status.comment-max-length
properties.description: Most characters in a comment on a status. Set with STATUS_COMMENT_MAX_LENGTH.

properties.name: status.past-visible-to-followers
properties.description: When true, followers can also open a person's past statuses. The owner always can. Set with STATUS_PAST_VISIBLE_TO_FOLLOWERS.

properties.name: group-invite.link-base-url
properties.description: What a group invite link starts with. The link is this, a slash and a random code. Point it at whatever should open when the link is tapped (the app or a web page). Set with GROUP_INVITE_BASE_URL.

properties.name: group-invite.max-expiry-hours
properties.description: The longest an admin can make a group invite link last, in hours. A link can also have no expiry at all. Set with GROUP_INVITE_MAX_EXPIRY_HOURS.

properties.name: group-invite.max-uses-limit
properties.description: The most joins an admin can limit a group invite link to. Set with GROUP_INVITE_MAX_USES_LIMIT.

properties.name: calls.livekit-url
properties.description: Address the apps connect to for call audio, video and screen sharing, for example wss://live.premisave.com. Set with LIVEKIT_URL.

properties.name: calls.livekit-api-url
properties.description: Address this service uses to reach the LiveKit server, to remove people, mute them and close finished rooms. Usually http://localhost:7880. Set with LIVEKIT_API_URL.

properties.name: calls.api-key
properties.description: LiveKit API key. Must match a key in the LiveKit server's config. Leave empty, together with the secret, to keep calls switched off. Set with LIVEKIT_API_KEY.

properties.name: calls.api-secret
properties.description: LiveKit API secret, at least 32 characters. Must match the secret the LiveKit server has for that key. Set with LIVEKIT_API_SECRET.

properties.name: calls.ring-timeout-seconds
properties.description: How many seconds phones ring before the call counts as missed. Set with CALLS_RING_TIMEOUT_SECONDS.

properties.name: calls.max-participants
properties.description: Most people allowed in one call at the same time. Set with CALLS_MAX_PARTICIPANTS.

properties.name: calls.ring-limit
properties.description: Most people a group call rings at once. Others in the group can still join from the chat. Set with CALLS_RING_LIMIT.

properties.name: calls.token-ttl-minutes
properties.description: How many minutes a call join token works. It is only needed to connect. Set with CALLS_TOKEN_TTL_MINUTES.

properties.name: calls.link-base-url
properties.description: What a call link starts with. The full link is this, a slash and the call code. Set with CALLS_LINK_BASE_URL.

properties.name: calls.link-ttl-hours
properties.description: The longest a call link stays valid, in hours. Set with CALLS_LINK_TTL_HOURS.

properties.name: calls.recording-enabled
properties.description: Starting value of the call recording switch. An administrator can change it from the dashboard and their choice then wins. When off, recording is hidden for everyone. Set with CALLS_RECORDING_ENABLED.

properties.name: calls.recordings-dir
properties.description: Folder the recorder writes call videos to, as this service sees it. Must be the same folder the recorder container writes to. Set with CALLS_RECORDINGS_DIR.

properties.name: calls.recordings-mode
properties.description: Where call recordings are kept: LOCAL (the folder in calls.recordings-dir) or NETWORK (a share the operating system has mounted at calls.recordings-network-mount-path). Set with CALLS_RECORDINGS_MODE.

properties.name: calls.recordings-network-mount-path
properties.description: NETWORK mode: where the share is mounted, as this service sees it. The service never mounts anything itself. Set with CALLS_RECORDINGS_NETWORK_MOUNT_PATH.

properties.name: calls.recordings-network-directory
properties.description: NETWORK mode: the folder inside the share for the videos. Blank means the mount path itself. The recorder must write to the same folder. Set with CALLS_RECORDINGS_NETWORK_DIRECTORY.

properties.name: calls.recordings-network-require-mount
properties.description: NETWORK mode: refuse to record unless the mount path really is on a network share, so videos never fill the local disk by mistake. Set with CALLS_RECORDINGS_NETWORK_REQUIRE_MOUNT.

properties.name: calls.recordings-min-free-mb
properties.description: Recording is refused when less than this many megabytes are free on the storage. 0 turns the check off. Set with CALLS_RECORDINGS_MIN_FREE_MB.

properties.name: calls.recordings-egress-dir
properties.description: The recordings folder as the recorder container sees it (where the folder is mounted inside the container). Set with CALLS_RECORDINGS_EGRESS_DIR.

properties.name: calls.recording-layout
properties.description: How a recorded call is laid out: speaker (the speaker is large, shared screens come to the front) or grid. Set with CALLS_RECORDING_LAYOUT.

properties.name: calls.recording-link-ttl-hours
properties.description: How long a link to watch a recording works, in hours. A new link is made every time the recordings of a call are loaded. Set with CALLS_RECORDING_LINK_TTL_HOURS.

properties.name: calls.chat-max-length
properties.description: Most characters in one message in a call's chat. Set with CALLS_CHAT_MAX_LENGTH.

properties.name: storage.mode
properties.description: Where attachments are stored: LOCAL (under storage.root) or NETWORK (a share already mounted by the operating system). Set with STORAGE_MODE.

properties.name: storage.root
properties.description: Base directory for attachments in LOCAL mode. Set with STORAGE_ROOT.

properties.name: storage.public-base-url
properties.description: Public address of this service, used to build attachment download links. Set with STORAGE_PUBLIC_BASE_URL.

properties.name: storage.max-file-size
properties.description: Largest single attachment. Keep spring.servlet.multipart.max-file-size in step with it. Set with STORAGE_MAX_FILE_SIZE.

properties.name: storage.url-ttl
properties.description: How long a signed attachment download link stays valid. Set with STORAGE_URL_TTL.

properties.name: storage.unclaimed-ttl
properties.description: How long an uploaded file that was never attached to a message is kept. Set with STORAGE_UNCLAIMED_TTL.

properties.name: storage.signing-secret
properties.description: Key used to sign download links. Leave blank to sign with jwt.secret. Set with STORAGE_SIGNING_SECRET.

properties.name: storage.allowed-roots
properties.description: Folders an administrator may point storage at from the dashboard (Settings, Storage), as full paths separated by commas (env STORAGE_ALLOWED_ROOTS). Blank allows only storage.root and storage.network.mount-path themselves.

properties.name: storage.network.protocol
properties.description: Protocol of the network share (informational). Set with STORAGE_NETWORK_PROTOCOL.

properties.name: storage.network.host
properties.description: Host of the network share (informational). Set with STORAGE_NETWORK_HOST.

properties.name: storage.network.share
properties.description: Name of the network share (informational). Set with STORAGE_NETWORK_SHARE.

properties.name: storage.network.mount-path
properties.description: Local path where the operating system has mounted the share. Used in NETWORK mode. Set with STORAGE_NETWORK_MOUNT_PATH.

properties.name: storage.network.directory
properties.description: Directory inside the mounted share that holds attachments. Set with STORAGE_NETWORK_DIRECTORY.

properties.name: storage.network.require-mount
properties.description: Refuse to start or write unless the mount path is on a mounted network share. Set with STORAGE_NETWORK_REQUIRE_MOUNT.

values.description: Trace level - most detailed, every method call and variable.
Debug level - detailed diagnostic information for debugging.
Info level - general informational messages about application flow.
Warn level - warning messages for potential issues.
Error level - error messages only, no warnings.
Fatal level - only critical errors that cause shutdown.
Off - disable logging for this logger completely.
Root logger level - applies to all loggers unless overridden.
